Dad: Which room was your favorite?
Jo: I expected to like the sea room, but the garden was best.
Dad: Why?
Jo: We could look at tiny models with a magnifying glass.
Dad: Which model did you like most?
Jo: The nest. It had the most interesting details.
Dad: Did you take photos?
Jo: No. I drew pictures in my notebook.
Dad: Are you going again on Saturday?
Jo: No, the show ends Friday. I am going Friday afternoon.
